relationship: 親に進路を反対された友達同士
setting: 親に進路を反対されたあと、友達に相談する
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I'm free to be whatever I
Whatever I choose and I'll sing the blues if I want
I'm free to say whatever I
Whatever I like if it's wrong or right, it's alright
[Chorus]
Always seems to me
You only see what people want you to see
How long's it gonna be
Before we get on the bus and 'cause no fuss?
Get a grip on yourself
It don't cost much
[Verse 2]
Free to be whatever you
Whatever you say if it comes my way, it's alright
You're free to be wherever you
Wherever you please you can shoot the breeze if you want
[Chorus]
It always seems to me
You only see what people want you to see
How long's it gonna be
Before we get on the bus and 'cause no fuss?
Get a grip on yourself
It don't cost much
[Verse 3]
I'm free to be whatever I
Whatever I choose and I'll sing the blues if I want
[Bridge]
Here in my mind
You know you might find
Something that you
You thought you once knew
But now it's all gone
And you know it's no fun
Yeah, I know it's no fun
Oh, I know it's no fun
[Verse 4]
I'm free to be whatever I
Whatever I choose and I'll sing the blues if I want
I'm free to be whatever I
Whatever I choose and I'll sing the blues if I want
[Outro]
Whatever you do
Whatever you say
Yeah, I know it's alright
Whatever you do
Whatever you say
Yeah, I know it's alright

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: My dad wants me to choose a safer career.
sentences.displayHtml: My dad wants me to choose a safer career.

sentences.text: I don't know how to tell him what I want.
sentences.displayHtml: I don't know how to tell him what I want.

conversation.japanese: 父はもっと安定した仕事を選んでほしいんだ。自分の希望をどう伝えたらいいかわからない。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: Forget everyone else's opinion for a minute.
sentences.displayHtml: Forget everyone else's opinion for a minute.

conversation.japanese: 君は何をしたいの？ 少しだけ、ほかの人の意見は置いておこう。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: It seems to me that I'm always waiting for permission.
sentences.displayHtml: It seems to me that I'm always waiting for permission.

conversation.japanese: 音楽を学びたい。いつも誰かの許可を待ってる気がする。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: You're free to choose your path.
sentences.displayHtml: You're free to choose your path.

sentences.text: You can still listen to his concerns.
sentences.displayHtml: You can still listen to his concerns.

conversation.japanese: 自分の道を選んでいいんだよ。お父さんの心配にも耳を傾けられるし。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: Then I'll explain why it matters and show him a realistic plan.
sentences.displayHtml: Then I'll explain why it matters and show him a realistic plan.

conversation.japanese: じゃあ、なぜ大切なのか説明して、現実的な計画を見せるよ。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: You don't need every answer tonight.
sentences.displayHtml: You don't need every answer tonight.

sentences.text: Just start with an honest conversation.
sentences.displayHtml: Just start with an honest conversation.

conversation.japanese: 今夜、全部の答えはいらないよ。まず正直に話すところから始めよう。

lyricConnections.explanationJa: It seems to me that ... は、自分にはそう思えると見方を伝える表現。
be free to + 動詞は、その行動を自由に選んでよいことを表す。
